body: Audited all draw_hero_model() cases, found and fixed two real near-duplicate silhouette pairs: Gary/Abraham (identical base + near-identical chest accent) and Cain/Tyler (identical base + accent too small to read). Gary got a rifle/scope side accent, Abraham a floating orb, Cain's mark moved to forehead and enlarged. Verified: clean build, full headless suite (337 checks). Commit b17ee23.
title: Unique skinmodels for all 24 heroes (S170-131)
